title: Article 8 Article 8  A person subject to a decision for commencement of guardianship becomes an adult ward, and an adult guardian is appointed for that person.
statute_text:
Article 8 Article 8  A person subject to a decision for commencement of guardianship becomes an adult ward, and an adult guardian is appointed for that person.
(Juridical Acts by Adult Wards under Guardianship)
